howToPlay: Avoid walls and sharp turns to maintain maximum speed, which increases damage and triggers knockups. Use the Super to gain speed and damage reduction while leaving a damaging trail behind. Manage speed carefully to maximize the shield from the Oil Change gadget and timing of the Bouncy Ball jump.
gears: Equip SPEED to capitalize on movement-based damage, SHIELD for extra survivability as a tank, and GADGET COOLDOWN to frequently utilize the Bouncy Ball and Oil Change gadgets.
trait: This brawler is ideal for players who excel at high-speed maneuvering and maintaining momentum during combat.
